data.name: Concrete Polishing Simulator
data.detailed_description:
FROM SLAB TO SHINE

Concrete Polishing Simulator is a hands-on, first-person simulation about transforming rough, damaged concrete into clean, polished, decorative floors.

Step into the boots of a professional concrete polisher, operate real-world-inspired equipment, and complete every stage of the floor-finishing process yourself.

Every floor begins unfinished. What it becomes depends on your tools, your technique, and the work you put into it.

DEVELOPED BY A CONCRETE POLISHER

Concrete Polishing Simulator is being developed by someone with real hands-on experience in the concrete polishing trade.

The tools, terminology, workflow, and progression are inspired by the processes used to turn unfinished concrete into a professional floor—from initial preparation and grinding to edge work, polishing, and sealing.

The goal is to capture the satisfying rhythm of the trade while keeping the experience approachable, visual, and rewarding.

TRANSFORM EVERY FLOOR

Concrete polishing is a process. Every job requires multiple stages, and every stage leaves a visible result.

Clear the work area, prepare the slab, grind the rough concrete, refine the floor through multiple passes, polish it to a clean finish, and seal the surface to complete the job.

Watch the slab transform beneath your tools as dull, unfinished concrete becomes smooth, refined, and reflective—one pass at a time.

DO THE WORK YOURSELF

This is not a menu-based job simulator. You are on the floor operating the equipment.

Push larger floor machines across open sections, use a hand grinder to reach edges and tighter areas, change tooling as the job progresses, and carefully cover the entire work area.

Different tools serve different purposes, and completing a professional floor means knowing when and where to use each one.

FOLLOW THE FLOOR-FINISHING PROCESS

Work through a real-world-inspired concrete finishing workflow that includes:

  • Surface preparation and cleanup

  • Grinding and cutting

  • Edge and detail work

  • Honing

  • Polishing

  • Staining

  • Sealing and finishing

  • Tooling changes for different stages

  • Complete floor coverage

Each stage contributes to the finished result and moves the contract closer to completion.

BUILD YOUR BUSINESS

Begin with smaller jobs, prove the quality of your work, and build your reputation as a concrete polishing contractor.

Complete contracts, earn money and reputation, improve your standing, and work toward larger residential, commercial, and industrial opportunities.

Your company name is on every job, so every floor counts.

FEATURES

  • Hands-on first-person concrete polishing gameplay

  • Visually reactive floors that change as you work

  • Multi-stage jobs covering preparation, grinding, honing, polishing, staining, and sealing

  • Large floor machines and detailed hand-grinder gameplay

  • Changeable tooling for different stages of the process

  • Edge work and complete floor-coverage requirements

  • Structured contracts with sandbox-style tool control

  • Job ratings based on the quality of your work

  • Earnings, reputation, and business progression

  • Real-world-inspired equipment and trade workflow

  • Residential, commercial, and industrial job potential

EVERY FLOOR TELLS A STORY

A rough, stained, unfinished slab can become something clean, professional, and reflective with the right equipment and enough care.

Take the contract. Work the floor. Build your name.

FROM SLAB TO SHINE.

data.short_description: Turn rough concrete into polished floors in a hands-on first-person simulator developed by a real concrete polisher. Operate professional equipment, complete every stage from preparation to sealing, and build your reputation one job at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Settings: Low–Medium for 1080p.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 (6-8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Settings: High for 1080p/60.
